pullRequests.title: fix(h5): release socket slots on server close
pullRequests.body:
**这个 PR 做了什么？**

Closes #19533

H5 WebSocket 被服务端关闭时，如果业务没有注册 `SocketTask.onClose`，内部连接列表不会释放该连接，累计 5 次后就无法重连。

在 SocketTask 构造时安装独立的 close 事件监听器，负责内部名额回收；业务 onClose 继续使用原来的回调逻辑。更新既有监听器数量断言，并新增服务端关闭的回归测试。

**这个 PR 是什么类型？**

- [x] 错误修复 (Bugfix) issue: #19533

**这个 PR 涉及以下平台：**

- [x] Web 端（H5）

**验证**

- WebSocket 新增及现有两份测试共 11 个用例通过。
- 新增场景覆盖无业务 onClose 的服务端关闭、注册回调后的清理、关闭后名额复用和 5 个活动连接的限制。
- 修复前新增测试中 2 个用例失败；修复后全部通过。
- 修改文件 ESLint、`git diff --check` 通过。
- 测试使用仓库现有 mock-socket Server，未声明真实网络浏览器端到端验证结果。

pullRequests.title: fix(core): recognize charset attributes in custom HTML templates
pullRequests.body:
## Motivation

Custom templates containing `<meta charset=utf-8>` or `<meta charset = 'utf-8'>` receive a second charset declaration. Similar attribute names or text inside quoted attribute values can also suppress the default declaration incorrectly.

Fixes #8669.

## Changes

Recognize charset attributes independently of value quoting and whitespace around `=`, while skipping quoted attribute values and requiring an attribute boundary. Preserve the template's existing declaration.

Add an HTML build regression covering unquoted and spaced declarations plus misleading attribute text. Exclude the two syntax fixtures from formatting so their input remains intact.

Validation: the new regression failed before the fix; `pnpm run build`, `pnpm run e2e cases/html` (75 tests), and `pnpm check` passed.

pullRequests.title: fix(frontend): preserve nonempty lists when pressing Enter
pullRequests.body:
## Description
Pressing Enter just before existing Markdown list text incorrectly treats the item as empty, removes its marker and skips the newline. Check the remaining text on the current line as well as the text before the caret before exiting a list.

Add regression coverage for bullets, numbered lists, tasks, indentation and surrounding lines, plus controls for splitting within text and genuinely empty items.

Fixes #4223

## Testing
- `npm test -- src/utils/markdownEditing.test.ts`: 33 passed; six new regression cases failed before the fix.
- `npm run type-check` and `npm run build`: passed (chunk-size warning).
- `git diff --check`: passed.

## Before / After
With the caret after `- ` in `- hello`, press Enter:
```text
Before: "hello"
After:  "- \n- hello"
```

pullRequests.title: fix(frontend): preserve inline images in EPUB previews
pullRequests.body:
## Description
EPUB previews resolve inline image data as ZIP paths and replace it with empty sources. Preserve `data:image/` sources for HTML images and SVG `href` / `xlink:href`, while keeping relative archive image resolution and Blob URL reuse unchanged. The preview continues through its existing HTML sanitizer.

Add ZIP-fixture regression tests covering inline HTML/SVG images, mixed archive and inline images, Blob contents/reuse, and rejection of non-image data or executable sources.

Fixes #4225

## Testing
- EPUB, document-preview Markdown and security tests: 15 passed; two EPUB regression cases fail against the original renderer.
- `npm run type-check`, `npm run build` and `git diff --check`: passed (build chunk-size warning).
- Chrome with the production renderer and `sanitizeHTML`: inline and ZIP raster images load, SVG inline references survive, and event attributes are removed.

pullRequests.title: fix(helm): configure app rollouts and document shared storage
pullRequests.body:
## Description
The Helm production example configures three App replicas with a shared ReadWriteOnce PVC, while the App update strategy is fixed to RollingUpdate.

- Add configurable App update strategies and rolling-update settings, preserving the existing defaults. Recreate omits the rollingUpdate block, and unsupported strategy types fail rendering.
- Update the production example to use one App replica with Recreate and explain the upgrade downtime.
- Add a multi-replica example using a pre-provisioned RWX claim and document its shared-storage requirements.
- Add seven template regression tests and run them in Helm CI.

## Related Issue
Fixes #4106

pullRequests.title: fix(frontend): respect Markdown indentation selection boundaries
pullRequests.body:
## Description
Selecting a Markdown line including its newline and pressing Tab or Shift+Tab also changes the next, unselected line. Treat the textarea selection end as exclusive when it falls at a line start, and preserve the selected trailing newline so repeated indentation continues to affect the same block.

Add regression coverage for Tab, Shift+Tab, empty final lines, repeated plain-text indentation and selections ending inside the following line. Existing caret and list behavior remains covered.

Fixes #4194

## Testing
- Editor tests: 25 passed; three new regression cases failed before the fix.
- `npm run type-check` and `npm run build` passed (build reports a chunk-size warning).
- Chrome keyboard checks passed in an isolated textarea harness using the repository helper: before/after Tab, Shift+Tab and repeated Tab.
- `git diff --check` passed.

## Before / After
Select `- first` and its newline in `- first\n- second`, then press Tab:
```text
Before: "  - first\n  - second"
After:  "  - first\n- second"
```

pullRequests.title: fix(runtime): correct alias after removing event listener
pullRequests.body:
**这个 PR 做了什么？**

修复小程序端 `Text` 和 `Image` 节点移除最后一个事件监听器时，运行时访问不存在的 `pure-text` / `pure-image` alias 导致崩溃的问题。

`hydrate()` 初始化无事件节点时遵循以下规则：

- 无提取属性的 `View` 使用 `pure-view`
- 其他 `View`、`Text`、`Image` 使用对应的 `static-*` alias

但 `removeEventListener()` 原先会将所有无提取属性的特殊节点切换为 `pure-*`，导致 `Text` 和 `Image` 分别访问不存在的 `pure-text` 和 `pure-image`。

本次修改使 `removeEventListener()` 的 alias 选择逻辑与 `hydrate()` 保持一致：

- `View` 且无提取属性：`pure-view`
- 其他特殊节点：`static-${nodeName}`

同时增加回归测试，覆盖：

- `Text` 移除最后一个事件监听器后切换到 `static-text`
- `Image` 移除最后一个事件监听器后切换到 `static-image`
- 无提取属性的 `View` 切换到 `pure-view`
- 有提取属性的 `View` 切换到 `static-view`
- 节点仍有其他监听器时不切换模板

Fixes #19453

pullRequests.body:
## Summary

- Support `taro init .` / `npx @tarojs/cli init .` by resolving `.` to the current directory name while keeping the target path as the current directory.
- Add unit coverage for `.` and `./` project names.

## Motivation

Closes #19249. This lets users initialize a Taro project directly in an existing current directory. Existing non-conflicting files are preserved by the existing template copy behavior, while same-name template files can still be overwritten.

## Validation

- `pnpm --filter @tarojs/cli exec jest packages/taro-cli/src/__tests__/project.spec.ts --runInBand`
- `pnpm --filter @tarojs/cli exec eslint src/create/project.ts src/__tests__/project.spec.ts`

Note: I also tried running `cli.spec.ts`, but this temporary worktree had unbuilt workspace package entries such as `@tarojs/service`, so that broader suite could not start in this local environment.
